free_swarm.cost_policy: OpenRouter :free routes only; every successful free call must report zero cost.

notes: Routine paid reviewers and the free swarm produce proposal evidence only.

Anthropic/Claude, NVIDIA/Nemotron and Mistral/Mistral AI are excluded by explicit human operator policy from Garden model use, provider routing, fallbacks, reviewer assignment and active contact. Historical references do not authorize operational use.

Routine material review uses the current cost/quality value board: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash and Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5. Expensive flagship models are escalation-only under the separate event-driven quality policy.
Gemini 3.8 Flash remains a separate direct Google-family lane under free-tier-only/no-paid-fallback policy; ChatGPT remains a separate external frontier lane and is not hardcoded by this repository.
The daily OpenRouter spend ceiling is fail-closed and checked from GET /api/v1/key before paid calls.
The legacy routine_hourly_cost_ceiling_usd field is an event-dispatch reservation envelope for compatibility; it is not a scheduling instruction.
Moving latest aliases are intentionally not used for evidence lineage; exact model identities stay pinned until a later catalog-review event.
Paid-model failure or budget-policy failure never weakens semantic admission requirements.
The coordinator remains paused until separately resumed; registering stronger models does not authorize provider calls or ChatGPT handoffs.

specialist_free_sweep.cost_policy: OpenRouter :free routes only; no paid fallback.

budget_relationship: The four pools allocate the initial $20 credit. All draws combined remain limited to $1 per UTC day. Allocations are not current balances or permission to spend reserves.

execution_limits.family_counts: Review-cycle diversity targets, accumulated over separate event-driven dispatches; not simultaneous calls or quota grants.
